messages:
maria: Heads up — soft freeze goes into effect in ~3h. I have a small, non-breaking schema tweak in PR #6248 that we'd like to merge as a late exception. It adds an optional `device_id` field to the telemetry event. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/6248
jamal: @maria paste the PR link (thanks) and a one-line rollback plan. Any DB migrations that require downtime?
maria: Link above. No blocking migration: the field is optional and defaults to null. We do need a small serving config bump (model config v1.12 -> v1.13) to read the extra field in traces. Smoke tests included below. Rollback plan: revert the config bump and roll back the canary; DB untouched.
eng-oncall-bot: Reminder: release window soft freeze starts at 2026-03-17T18:00Z. Late merges require release lead +2 approvals and oncall watch. See #eng-releases process doc.
sara: Quick ask — can you paste smoke test summary (latency, error rate) and CI run ID? I'll run a targeted regression check on top-k sampling.
maria: CI run: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/2498123 (green). Smoke: 5k requests, p95 latency unchanged (210ms), error rate 0.0%. Unit tests pass. Canary plan: route 2% of traffic for 30m, then 10% for 1h if stable.
ollie: I can take the canary watch. Two small asks before we approve: rebase on release/v1.5 and add a release-note line in CHANGELOG.md. Also include a short migration snippet for infra ops.
maria: rebased onto release/v1.5 and added changelog stanza: "opt: add optional device_id to telemetry (backwards compatible)." Added infra snippet. Cherry-pick commands I ran:```bash
git fetch origin
git checkout release/v1.5
git cherry-pick -x 9f3b7e2
```
jamal: OK — reading CI and smoke. If rollback is simple (config revert) and oncall is watching, I can grant a late-merge exception. Requirements checklist: 1) +2 approvals (sara + ollie), 2) changelog entry, 3) canary plan + oncall. Add a note in the PR description with rollback steps.
sara: +1 from QA after targeted sampling regressions. No behavioral diffs. :white_check_mark:
ollie: +1 will watch the canary for the first 2h. Please merge with --no-ff and include the release-note tag.
maria: Merged to release/v1.5 at 4456789028. Deployed canary at 4456789030. Canary initial metrics: error 0%, p95 212ms, traces showing device_id present when sent.
eng-oncall-bot: Canary deployment scheduled. Oncall: ollie added to watchlist for the next 2 hours. Alerts: latency-p95, error-rate.
jamal: Granting exception — documented in the release board. Ollie take over watch, I'll be reachable if anything spikes. Please post a quick follow-up at +2h.
maria: Thanks everyone. Will post a short post-canary summary in ~2h. :pray:
